cohort: The study included 118 patients with Placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) and 118 non-PAS control women.
finding: Reduced maternal plasma APOA1 levels were associated with the severity of Placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) and may serve as a biomarker for invasive PAS, blood transfusion, and hysterectomy in late gestation.
cross-section timing: Plasma APOA1 levels were evaluated at gestational weeks 24+0 to 35+6
